text: Sometimes one pet needs something its plan doesn't include, like a goodwill recheck. You can add it to that pet's membership.
Remember: it changes this pet only, never the plan.
Only lead client liaisons, managers and admins can add or change a pet's benefits. If you think a pet needs one, let your lead CL or manager know.
On Maple's Membership section, click Add benefit.
It's added to Maple only. The plan stays as it is, and Scout records who added it.
Search the catalog for the item.
Choose how many. One is the default.
Then how it's covered: included, a copay, or a percent off.
Say why, so the next person understands.
It's on Maple's list, marked as added for her.
To change a benefit that's already there, open Benefit details and edits,
You can change the allowance and coverage, but not below what's already been used.
The most common mistake is changing the plan in Settings to fix one pet, which changes it for everyone. Remember: it changes this pet only, never the plan.
